response.sql: WITH p AS (SELECT COALESCE(pr.fundflux, '__MISSING__') AS fund, COUNT(DISTINCT pr.arcregistry) AS n FROM scanqc q JOIN projects pr ON pr.arcregistry = q.arcref GROUP BY COALESCE(pr.fundflux, '__MISSING__')) SELECT CASE WHEN fund = '__MISSING__' THEN NULL ELSE fund END AS fundflux, n AS project_count, n * 1.0 / SUM(n) OVER () AS fraction_of_total, n * 1.0 / AVG(n * 1.0) OVER () AS ratio_to_average FROM p
